prompt.project_info: Photorealistic vertical beach portrait at sunset with a modern white bikini.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm natural golden-hour glow with soft long shadows and highlights on white fabric and hair, quiet confident seaside mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution professional photorealistic photography, sharp subject, realistic candid beach style, natural skin detail and sunset color.
